name: Kazuyo
source:
Contestant #1 in the Under 20 Talent Contest, she becomes enraged when the announcement is made that Mutsumi has won. 

Taking things into her own hands, Kazuyo proceeds to show off that she's still more talented than her rival could ever be.

From "Afternoon" story.
